pages.title: Error-Correction Lattice
pages.text: Thousands of physical qubits standing guard over one logical qubit. Each error is caught by the neighbours, which vote it out before it can spread. It is a delicate lattice of light, cold to touch, and remarkably stable.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)My qubits kept losing coherence. In the Neural Synthesizer, I let a Quantum Processor arrange Qubits around a Superposition Crystal, using Synaptic Fluid to learn which errors to vote out.
